SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."County Code" = s."County"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda';

SELECT MAX(frm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm frm
JOIN schools sch ON frm."County Code" = sch."County"
WHERE frm."County Name" = 'Alameda';

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.`County Code` = schools.`County`
WHERE frpm.`County Name` = 'Alameda';
